Microsoft Fabric vs. Power BI is the most searched question online in data analysis space.
Power BI is a reporting tool that is used for visualization whereas Fabric is an end to end analytics platform that includes Power BI plus many other tools like Data Factory, Synapse, Lakehouses and Warehouses on OneLake, and AI Data agents.

For current Power BI developers Fabric is a great opportunity to upskill and become a future ready Full Stack Data Professional.
